name: Flash Tattoo Co.
tagline: Custom tattoos and walk-in flash from a small, bright studio with three chairs and no attitude.
walkin_note: Walk-in flash Fridays and Saturdays, noon until the sheet runs out.
age_note: 18+ only, with photo ID. No exceptions, not even with a parent.
deposit_note: A $100 deposit holds your date and comes off the price of the tattoo.

steps.title: Consult
steps.body: Twenty minutes, free, in person or on a call. Bring references, a placement and a rough size.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.body: A $100 deposit holds your date and comes off the final price.

steps.title: Drawing
steps.body: Your artist draws the piece and shows it to you the day before. Changes are welcome.

steps.title: Session
steps.body: Stencil, placement check, then the needle. You leave with aftercare and a touch-up promise.

faqs.question: How do walk-ins work?
faqs.answer: Pick a design off the flash wall, give the front desk your name, and we tattoo in the order you arrived. Each piece is tattooed once, then stamped taken.

faqs.question: What does a tattoo cost?
faqs.answer: Flash has its price on the tag. Custom work is quoted at your consult, with a $120 shop minimum.

faqs.question: Can you cover up an old tattoo?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. Send a clear photo in daylight and we will tell you honestly what will work.

faqs.question: How should I prepare?
faqs.answer: Sleep, eat a real meal, and skip alcohol the night before. Wear something that leaves the spot easy to reach.

art_direction.identity: The studio's own photocopied flyer: copier-paper white canvas, toner-black type, one sheet of hot-pink paper, photographs taped onto the page at a slight tilt, and rubber stamps. Bright and handmade, never the moody black photo grid.
art_direction.type: Dela Gothic One, uppercase, for every heading and the brand; Albert Sans for all running text. Headlines are heavy, stacked and tight; body stays plain and calm.
art_direction.color: One accent: hot pink (bg-primary) used as a FIELD — the styles ribbon, the flash wall's background, a highlighter strip behind one word, the main button — always with ink-black text on it. Never pink text on the white canvas. Dark bands are ink (bg-secondary) with paper-white text.
art_direction.signature: The flash wall — flash designs pinned as numbered paper tags with size and price, and a TAKEN rubber stamp once a piece is claimed. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Short, dry and a little punk. Plain about prices, deposits and rules. No exclamation points, no hype, no 'ink journey'.
